newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in active market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in active market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed at Tuesday's level of 43.7475/7495 to the dollar in an active session of the interbank market on Wednesday. dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 43.7470/7500 per dollar in early trade but most deals were done at 43.7480/7490 level.
Dealers said trade was active, with many banks requiring dollars for payment against imports.
Call money closed higher at 6.25 to 6.45 percent from a previous five to six percent on increased borrowing of taka by banks buying dollars.
